Operations.Name: CronjobCreate
Operations.Description:
Create a new cron job.

`stderr` and `stdout` are boolean values which if `true`, represent that we would like to suppress
standard error / standard output respectively.

Arguments.Name: data
Arguments.Description: Cron job configuration data for the new job.

Arguments.Name: id
Arguments.Description: ID of the cron job to delete.

Operations.Name: CronjobRun
Operations.Description: Job to run cronjob task of `id`.

Arguments.Name: id
Arguments.Description: ID of the cron job to run immediately.

Arguments.Name: skip_disabled
Arguments.Description: Whether to skip execution if the cron job is disabled.

Arguments.Name: id
Arguments.Description: ID of the cron job to update.

Fields.Description: Shell command or script to execute.

Fields.Description: Human-readable description of what this cron job does.

Fields.Name: Enabled
Fields.Description: Whether the cron job is active and will be executed.

Fields.Name: Id
Fields.Description: Unique identifier for the cron job.

Fields.Name: Schedule
Fields.Description: Cron schedule configuration for when the job runs.

Fields.Name: Stderr
Fields.Description: Whether to IGNORE standard error (if `false`, it will be added to email).

Fields.Name: Stdout
Fields.Description: Whether to IGNORE standard output (if `false`, it will be added to email).

Fields.Name: User
Fields.Description: System user account to run the command as.
